lines: Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, had seen the fire turn cool. He had seen his Lord answer his duas. And still, he asked his Lord for one more thing.
"My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead."
Allah said: have you not believed? He said: "Yes, but only that my heart may be satisfied."
So Allah told him: take four birds, and draw them close to you. Then put a portion of them on each hill. Then call them.
Call them, Allah said, and they will come to you in haste. And know that Allah is Exalted in Might, and Wise.
Faith does not mean you never ask. It means you ask the One who has the answer.
